name: ghl-integration-kit
description: GoHighLevel marketplace install, signed webhooks, and a speed-to-lead flow, with a mock so it runs without a GHL account.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/mock-ghl/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/console/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --coverage packages/domain apps/api/src apps/console/lib apps/worker/src
scripts.test:workers: mkdir -p apps/console/out && [ -f apps/console/out/index.html ] || printf '%s\n' '<!doctype html><title>Northwind</title>' > apps/console/out/index.html && vitest run -c apps/worker/vitest.config.ts
scripts.build:workers: npm run build:console:cf && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker
